x: Our next man home, Doug Maugham, gave a very creditable performance in his first "twenty", easily breaking the two hour barrier and taking 2nd place to Lionel in the Beds. & Hunts.

Congratulations to Elaine and Mick Gleave on the safe arrival of Elliot John who arrived a few hours ahead of that other 1982 celebrity -Prince William. One regular,missing from the September 5¾ was Doug. Maugham who chose the 18th Sept. for his nuptials.
